Reflections – Luxury 6BR Beachfront Estate with Private Pool & Gulf Views on 30A

Welcome to Reflections, a breathtaking 6-bedroom beachfront estate located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach along Scenic Highway 30A. This exclusive Gulf-front home combines timeless architectural elegance with modern coastal luxury, offering panoramic ocean views, a private pool, direct beach access, and accommodations for large families or groups seeking the ultimate 30A getaway.

Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion, reconnecting with loved ones, or simply unwinding by the waves, there will be plenty to reflect on here.

Elegant Coastal Design & Inviting Interiors

With grand colonial-inspired architecture and a coastal-chic interior, Reflections captures both sophistication and serenity. Step inside to find blonde wood floors, crisp white shiplap walls, and elevated coffered ceilings that create a bright, airy atmosphere throughout.

The sprawling great room features floor-to-ceiling windows framing the emerald waters of the Gulf, filling the space with natural light. Relax in the plush living area with a large flat-screen TV, or gather in the chef’s kitchen, complete with high-end stainless steel appliances, a grand island with bench seating, and a dining area for eight.

Private Pool, Expansive Deck & Direct Beach Access

Step through the patio doors onto your sun-soaked Gulf-front deck, where you’ll find a private pool, ample lounge seating, and unbeatable views of the turquoise waters. Take your private staircase directly down to the sand, enjoy evening cocktails as the sun sets over the horizon, and let the sounds of the surf set the tone for true relaxation.

6 Bedrooms + Bonus Spaces | Sleeps Up to 20 Guests

Every bedroom at Reflections is designed for comfort, privacy, and a restful night’s sleep.

Master Suite: King bed, private balcony, and spa-style ensuite with soaking tub, dual vanities, and a walk-in shower.

Four Gulf-Front Guest Suites: Each with private balcony access, ensuite bathrooms, and stunning ocean views.

Kid’s Bunk Room: Two twin bunk beds with individual TVs, perfect for younger guests.

Bonus Room: Two twin beds with trundles and a large flat-screen TV, providing additional flexible sleeping arrangements.

Luxury Features & Premium Amenities

Reflections offers an array of upscale touches designed for effortless comfort and convenience:

Private pool with ocean views

Three mini bars located throughout the home

Secondary living area with kitchen & balcony, ideal for extended families

Two laundry areas for longer stays

Private beach access steps from your door

Explore the Best of 30A & Santa Rosa Beach

Perfectly positioned near the area’s top attractions, Reflections offers both seclusion and convenience:

The Vue on 30A – Next door, enjoy Caribbean-inspired seafood and spectacular sunset dining.

Gulf Place Town Center – Walk to local coffee shops, art galleries, boutiques, and restaurants.

Scenic 30A Communities – Explore Seaside, WaterColor, and Grayton Beach via the nearby bike path.

Destin & Miramar Beach – Just a short drive away for world-class shopping, golf, and family entertainment.

Book Your Stay at Reflections

With unparalleled Gulf views, luxurious amenities, and direct beach access, Reflections is more than just a vacation home, it’s an experience. Whether you’re soaking up the sun, hosting family dinners by the sea, or exploring the best of 30A, this Santa Rosa Beach beachfront estate is the perfect destination for your next unforgettable escape.

POOL HEAT
A $50.00 per day fee is added to reservations booked between 10/1 - 4/30 for Pool Heat. If you prefer to have an unheated pool, please email or call after booking and the fees will be immediately refunded.
PLEASE NOTE: The pool cannot be heated if it is below 52 degrees or above 80 degrees. As your stay gets closer, we will do our best to keep you informed of the forecast during that time period. We will immediately refund you if conditions do not allow for this.

COMPLIMENTARY BEACH SERVICE
Beach Service is provided seasonally from 3/1 to 10/31, weather permitting, and is only offered during regular business hours until 5pm. This service includes 6 chairs and 3 umbrellas!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Located in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is on the beach. While the natural beauty of Blue Mountain Beach and Grayton Beach State Park can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Traveling with kids? Consider Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze. Discover the area's water adventures with jet skiing and scuba diving nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with mountain biking and cycling.
